title: Situation
description: A life or business situation (opening a bar, closing a business, a fine in the post) and the procedures it involves. It only points at procedures: every fact, deadline and source stays on the procedures' own pages.

id.description: The file name under situations/ without .yaml

headline.description: The page title in the words people search with

updated.description: The last day anything in this file changed, as for procedures

intro.description: Two or three plain-Italian sentences: who this is for, and that each procedure says whether it applies

procedure.description: id of a procedure in the library

when.description: What this procedure is for in this situation, in a few words; no deadlines or amounts, which come from the procedure
